simple.summary: דִּמְיוֹן (dimyôwn) means resemblance First listed occurrence: Ps 17 12.

definitions.full: H1825. dimyon [ דִּמְיֹן ] noun [masculine] likeness , כְּאַרְיֵה דִּמְיֹנוֺ Psa 17:12 his likeness is as a lion , i.e. he is like a lion.
